actions.reason: C0001 has coherent multi-modality identity evidence (metabolic down-regulation, DNA-repair up-regulation, 9p/9q loss, PBRM1/SETD2 trends), no localized technical confounding, and positive fused boundary separation with modest per-modality support. Silhouettes are near zero, so residual uncertainty remains, but no material unresolved question requires an available request and no better-supported structural revision is indicated.

C0002 has coherent RNA/CNV identity evidence (MYC-down, KRAS-DN, low FGA) with positive fused boundary separation and consistent membership support. A significant tissue_source_site:BP association is a concerning competing explanation for part of the signal, but it does not by itself establish artifact and no available request could resolve it further; the candidate remains defensible for downstream validation with this caveat.

C0003 has strong coherent identity evidence (inflammatory/immune RNA program with striking BAP1 enrichment and PBRM1 depletion), no localized technical confounding, and positive fused boundary separation. Coherence is predominantly WXS-driven with several near-zero modality silhouettes, so uncertainty remains, but no material unresolved question requires an available request and no better-supported structural revision is indicated.

C0004 has strong coherent WXS identity evidence (marked VHL and PBRM1 depletion with 9q/JAK2 gain and depleted 3p gene losses), no localized technical confounding, and positive fused boundary separation. Cross-modal coherence is WXS-dominated with negative non-WXS silhouettes, so uncertainty remains, but no material unresolved question requires an available request and no better-supported structural revision is indicated.

C0005 has coherent RNA identity evidence (upregulated metabolic/lipid/peroxisome pathways with DST enrichment), no localized technical confounding, and positive fused boundary separation. Per-modality support is essentially absent and several patients lack any positive modality, so uncertainty remains, but no material unresolved question requires an available request and no better-supported structural revision is indicated.

C0006 has strong coherent WXS identity evidence (universal VHL mutation with PBRM1-wildtype tendency) and positive fused boundary separation. A significant ct_phase:NEPH association is a concerning competing explanation for part of the signal, but it does not by itself establish artifact and no available request could resolve it further; the candidate remains defensible for downstream validation with this caveat.
